name: Invite links: a single-use link that makes an account or adds memberships to one, with one pre-approved agent
aliases: Invite someone or add an agent
summary: A person's session (never an agent or worker credential) that is a superuser or an owner of every named project makes an invite, checked at create and again at use. It names a new person, or an existing account (person: existing, kittrial-5bb.581). state['invites'] keeps only the token's SHA-256 (secrets.token_urlsafe(32)), the projects, the role, an optional worker or reviewer agent (no coordinator grant, no scopes) and an expiry of 72 hours by default, at most 7 days. A new person redeems on the signed-out page (#/invite/TOKEN) with POST /v1/invites/redeem and a password. An existing account accepts only with its own session at POST /v1/invites/accept (CSRF): missing memberships are added with the named role (owner only from a superuser), and none is lowered. Either way one Service._widening under the state lock makes the memberships, the agent and its credential, and marks the invite used; any failure takes all of it back. Unknown, expired, used and revoked tokens, the wrong kind and the wrong person get one 404, counted as failed sign-ins. Each use writes invites.redeemed into each project's audit. Off unless invites_enabled.
